name: flash-warpx-kinetic-patch-v1
description: One-way FLASH-to-WarpX kinetic follow-up: a working FLASH island trajectory and tested coordinate, flux-potential, dimensional and particle-initialization helpers. Supplied checks are non-evidentiary.
operator_validation: The same FLASH wrapper and executable completed a fresh ResearchService anchor. The extraction, SI mapping and fully kinetic CPU initializer separately completed recorded exploratory launches; initial loaded E/B fields matched the prepared data exactly. GPU readiness is checked separately before the campaign. These establish execution and transfer readiness only.
limitations: Every supplied operator/anchor artifact is permanently non-evidentiary. The study must generate its own FLASH trajectory and fresh WarpX evidence.
One-way initial-condition transfer is not a two-way MHD/PIC coupler.
The kinetic realization is collisionless and reduced-mass-ratio; scalar FLASH resistivity is not evolved by PIC.
Physical scaling, patch/boundary effects, initialization relaxation, particle/grid controls and pressure diagnostics require independent methods review.
The source exporter supports the normalized 2D, single-output-block island application with zero out-of-plane initial field/flow, not general FLASH AMR states.
